## Objetivo
Connect existing React resource views to T13's authenticated SSE contract. Own canonical client refetch, reconnect and cleanup behavior plus focused two-context browser evidence. Do not change server transport or publication. T11 later extends this client contract to play/history/leaderboard views using T14's APIs.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Fast client tests verify invalidations refetch mounted collection, member lists, polls, confirmed nights and suggestions from canonical APIs, including deleted games and replaced attendee snapshots. Reconnect refetches current state even if an event was missed. Test duplicate effect setup/cleanup under React StrictMode and prevent stale requests from restoring obsolete state. Dispose EventSource listeners/connections on unmount and logout; authentication failure clears private view state and does not reconnect indefinitely.
- [ ] Focused Playwright tests at 1280x720 and 390x844 use two authenticated contexts to demonstrate votes and confirmations updating the second context without reload. Assertions include the visible vote counts and attendee snapshot; synchronize on subscription readiness and visible conditions, never fixed sleeps. T11 owns corresponding play-driven browser scenarios.
- [ ] Browser tests reuse T01 diagnostics and isolated current-code webServer, include pageerror/console.error in failure messages and capture descriptive viewport-only updated poll/confirmation states under test-results/screens/ after scrolling evidence into view. npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass; run_browser_tests runs npm run test:e2e. No server changes are required for acceptance.
